changes.note: API request version previously set by ShopifyAPI::Base.api_version, now configured in ShopifyAPI::Context.setup.
Previously used to set User-Agent and custom headers. Now configured via ShopifyAPI::Context.setup and ShopifyAPI::Clients::HttpRequest.
Deprecated the dependency of graphql-client and ActiveResource gems. REST and GraphQL requests must be refactored to use the new client classes.
Helper methods to load related resource connections (like order.transactions) are no longer supported unless the connected property is explicitly listed in the REST API.
